facts.text: Evan and his partner are expecting a child, and they are excited about the upcoming parenthood experience.

evidence.quote: Wanted to share some amazing news - my partner is pregnant! We're so excited!
Parenthood is so amazing. How are you feeling about it?
It's been a while since I had a toddler around but I'm really looking forward to it. Parenthood is so rewarding.

facts.text: Evan shared a collage of family memories with Sam, including a photo of a desk with a lamp, a picture frame, and a sign.

evidence.quote: I want to show you this. It's a collage of some of our top family memories. Each photo has an amazing moment - birthdays, holidays, vacations - so good to look back and recall all the great times we had.

facts.text: The sign in the center of the photo is from a trip to Banff and reads 'Bring it on Home', which is described as the family's motto emphasizing togetherness.

evidence.quote: That one? It's from our trip to Banff. We have this sign in the frame that says 'Bring it on Home' - it's our family's motto, always reminding us of the importance of togetherness, no matter where we are.
